comment: BNpcBase 9020, the director's helper retail uses in many duties (layout 0, level 1, 44 HP, never seen). ONE file for the base: the server takes the first file it finds ending `_9020.json`, and until 2026-11-18 there were two (this and CopperbellHelper_9020.json), so one duty's amounts or the other's were never used: Cape Westwind's 28869 took 7 from Bob where retail's takes about 1060 (test `one_timeline_file_for_each_base`). The Copperbell Mines (was CopperbellHelper_9020.json): the first boss's three (layout 9054923), which the director puts on Kottos' landing spots to cast 28544, and the last boss's five (layout 9060684), which it puts round the arena to cast 28761 (w1d1_re.lua). 28544 never caught anyone in Bob's three runs (Chronofoil captures of 2026-10-25): its amounts are a stand-in, the first boss's 28546's. 28761 hit one player for 127 (the Duty Support run). In Brayflox's Longstop: the last boss's fourteen (no layout ID on retail; the fork's 99009020), two on each of the puddles' seven spots, which cast 28657 (293 on the player, Bob's capture 44df02fc of 2026-11-03) and 28658 (307) as the director says (s1d2_re.lua). In the Stone Vigil: the last boss's eight (no layout ID on retail; the fork's 99009020), four of which cast 1024 (a 2.7 s circle) at each party member at once, twice, as the boss flies (1939 on the player, Bob's Chronofoil capture 1cefedf4 of 2026-11-07 (the Stone Vigil with Duty Support, `questkit chronofoil --battle`); r1d1_re.lua). No auto-attack, no timepoints: it acts only when the director says. Cape Westwind (InstanceContent 5060; content/questbattle/5060.lua; four runs: Bob's Chronofoil captures 667a68c5 of 2026-11-16 and 9ba7d981 of 2026-11-17 (visits 0.6 and 0.8) and Connor's e834e436): twelve of them on the boss's spot until the director puts one somewhere to cast. 28865 (3.7 s cast, no target: 810 and 832), 28867 (no cast, on whoever struck the boss's raised shield from in front: 769 and Knockback 7, once), 28869 (7.7 s: 1015, 1105; 913 parried), 28880 (0.2 s on the player: effect 32, the Attract sheet's row 17, which draws them to the helper), 28882 (2.7 s: 448, 455, and 910 once). Their animation lock is 0.6 every time (82 uses). The Ultimate Weapon's last battle (InstanceContent 5061; content/questbattle/5061.lua; Connor's Chronofoil capture af05916c (2026-11-09, visit 0.14: won in 528 s from the pull) and Bob's 9ba7d981 (2026-11-17, visit 0.22: won in 527 s; 0.20, left after 29 s)): 29330 (no cast: 708 once), 29758 (4.7 s: 192 to 248), 29788 (no cast, on the player: Knockback 68 and status 1614), 29565 (no cast, on the player: 9999999), and 29329, 29335, 29756 and 29760, which hit no one in the runs. The Porta Decumana (ContentFinderCondition 830; content/w1d5_battle.lua; Connor's Chronofoil capture af05916c (2026-11-09, visit 0.12) and Bob's 9ba7d981 (2026-11-17, visit 0.18), both with Duty Support): 29012 (4.7 s, on each of the party: 925 to 1001 and 369 to 958), 29014 (4.7 s, on one of them, everyone near sharing it: 829 to 948 and 310 to 917), 29021 (6.7 s, four at once: 135 to 248 and 54 to 172 a hit), 29008 to 29010 (1.9 s: 1028, 446 and 1062 the three times one caught a member), and 28980, 28983, 28991 and 29001, which hit no one in the runs; 28511, 28542, 28988 and 28992 (no cast) showed nothing but themselves. Castrum Meridianum (ContentFinderCondition 15; content/w1d4_re.lua; Connor's Chronofoil capture af05916c (2026-11-09, visit 0.8) and Bob's 9ba7d981 (visit 0.12) and 50e72631 (visit 0.3) of 2026-11-17, all with Duty Support): the first boss's 29269 (no cast, three in turn on everyone: 286 and 248); the second's 28779 (7 s, a circle of 20: 743 and 601), 28781 and 28782 (5 s, a circle of 10 and a ring from 12.5: 1288 to a player), 28784 (3 s, a circle of 5 under each of the party: 1228 to a member); the last's 28787 (7 s), 29163 (5 s: 1207 and 507), 28793 and 28794 (7.2 s: 1182 and 1170), 28797 (2.5 s: 1302 and 512), 28790 (4 s: 1160), 29164 (4 s: 1152) and 29356 (7 s: 180 and 156).
